answer: Quota tree, 5 invites per node. Every unverified claim burns one invite, permanently. Addresses are not the unit. Tasks are. Edge case that matters: one identity on a shared bridge node faked 3 claims, its quota hit zero and its 11 children went dark in the same epoch. Farming 500 accounts means 500 finished tasks plus 100 live parent accounts, or the wharf side stops renewing. A grafted juniper branch inherits nothing, new accounts start at 1 invite.
